lines: Active rows: C001 callback and candidate-constructor location, standalone decoder, exact-window cases and frame replay.
F- IDs form one space across `docs/ledgers/findings/`; retired rows keep their
full text under `retired/`. Admission and columns follow `.agents/rules/docs.md`.

fields.claim: Normal-return Win64 ABI inference can conditionally preserve RBX; unwind intent alone cannot establish receiver continuity
fields.scope_and_limits: medium; default ABI and local static joins; requires local paths, save-slot/home-area and argument joins; no target conformance or archive proof

fields.claim: C001 slot notes conflict: base 0x1449d9f90 (F-908) plus 0xa0/0x488/0x4a0 gives 0x1449da030/0x1449da418/0x1449da430, the stated +0x488/+0x4a0 ones 0x4000 high, so hypothetical frame success cannot clear slot ownership
fields.scope_and_limits: medium; arithmetic; vptr, origin, slot contract unproved

fields.claim: The standalone C001 decoder decodes fixed x64 buffers via the PseudoInstruction API without Program, PE import or analyzers; fixture v2 (nonzero-call oracle) and 106-B and 196/217-B variants pass ten modes; the first suite failed

Server exception directory valid (323,249 records); .pdata 103538 (callback 0x1419fe870, 305 B) and 95461 (candidate 0x141788530, 296 B) are whole C001 functions (unwind v1, rbx saved); the old listing rejection was -noanalysis (null)
fields.evidence: static-bytes, static-decompile; M-007, M-008, M-011, M-761/ev_73f0199d703e, M-762

fields.claim: C001 getter 0x1419fe200 matches the client's GetPrivateStaticClass (178 B) but for 13 rel32 fields, its ctor field 0x1419fe870 being InternalConstructor<C001>; sole reference 0x14655d468 is .pdata (F-722); reflection getter 0x141a00220 differs
Exact C001 windows decode with zero lookahead: callback/candidate 305/296 B as 51/49 instructions; common callee 0x1418824d0 (106 B) as 24; its callees (196/217 B) as 45/48; byte replays agree
fields.scope_and_limits: high; no complete function, receiver, ABI or archive proof

fields.claim: C001 windows call 0x1418824d0, then (candidate: 49 states, RBX kept; callback via RBX) store 0x1449d9f90 at +0, 0x1449da448 at +0x28 of RCX: primary and IInterface_AssetUserData vftables, per the client ctor
fields.evidence: static-pcode, controlled-partial, static-bytes; M-181, M-193..M-195, M-209..M-211, M-221..M-223, M-303..M-309

fields.claim: C001 frame inputs qualify: three 12-byte v1 unwind records (register 3 pushes, 48/32/48-byte allocations, opaque handlers); 1,480 register descriptors with six named GPR shapes; four byte-addressed spaces; opcode constants 27 and 72-75
fields.scope_and_limits: high; storage geometry only; handler data unread

fields.claim: C001 frame cases exit 0 at controlled stops; the callee model completes; constructors stop at a RAX low16 store; admitting AX/AL reads overflows the 64 KiB bundle cap

C001 vftable +0xa0 Serialize calls UActorComponent::Serialize then +0x488 (24-B call-free version hook); +0x4a0 calls the base restore then +0x4b0 apply-transform; server 0x1418aaf70/0x14189d380/0x1418a9bb0/0x141887d20 match the client but for constants; C028 inherits two

0x14655d468 is .pdata 103518 for 0x1419fe200 (48 refs; CRT 0x1406a8ab0 -> 0x142187f70, 0x141a00220 via 0x144abc1b0); 0x1418824d0 keeps rbx; 0x1418a9c80 (696 B) matches client 0x1418ae6c0 (507 B) + log and calls +0xa0 (0x1418aaf70) -> +0x488; +0x4a8=0x14189a760
